integrity: Complete proof with symbolic and deterministic finite numerical checks; no claim of independent verification or certification.
scientific_limitations: Stationary one-dimensional noninteracting Ornstein–Uhlenbeck particles, strictly positive confinement, diffusion, common Poisson rate, and retention strictly between zero and one.
The lower-tail statement is a logarithmic-scale limit, not a prefactor.
Moment inversion assumes known confinement and diffusion coefficients and exact limiting moments.
Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive priority search have not been performed.
title: Exact beta edge and quadratic-log cooling tail in a synchronously partially reset harmonic Brownian gas
